targets.expr:

  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, region, runtime) (

, "project", "${exclude_projects}"))) or vector(0)

  label_replace(vector(0), "runtime", "general-purpose", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "runtime", "unikernel", "", ""),
  "runtime", "$runtime"
)
